verdicts.reason: Both use the same left-to-right leaderboard layout: the logo sits in a white box with the 'Limited Summer Release' kicker tucked under it, a four-line headline crammed into the centre column, and body copy squeezed into about 8px text that is unreadable at banner size. The fine print competes with the CTA, and the button and 'Ships late June' are tiny and jammed against the right edge. B's 'Reserve a Case' pill is a little larger and its label sits less tightly, so it is marginally better, but the two are nearly identical.
